decision: exit condition: PLAN phases 0-5 each pass their two-browser demo driven by the verify-reading-together skill, plus typecheck and tests green on master
why: owner asked for an endless autonomous build; a countable predicate keeps it honest

decision: run as Autonomous run with a Feature-style fan-out per phase, not the full Orchestrate store
why: one local repo, no remote, about 6 phases; the orch CLI and PR stack would be ceremony here

decision: decided the open spoiler question: partner position and chapter-finished pushes stay visible
why: they reveal pace, not story content, and seeing the partner ahead nudges reading together; marks ahead stay fully hidden per D9

decision: no PRs: work lands as small verified commits on master
why: repo has no remote; opening-a-pr needs one

decision: spoiler gate compares against a never-decreasing max_pos, and events carry pos so they are gated too
why: otherwise rereading chapter 1 would hide marks already seen, and a mark_created event in the timeline would leak a hidden mark

decision: merged the scaffold after fixing a stub fixture, a broken cn import and stale deps
why: the worker reported PASS but its alice.epub was a hand-made 1-paragraph stub and the button imported cn from an npm package
result: build typecheck test green on master

decision: excluded .claude/worktrees from vitest, tsc and git
why: master's test run picked up a worker's copy of the tests (2 instead of 1)

decision: picked foliate-js over epub.js by measurement
why: epub.js default parsing shifted 4 of 15 spine lengths by one char, which would break the spoiler gate comparison; foliate matched Node byte for byte

decision: carried spike follow-ups into P12 and P13 briefs: messy-EPUB errors, server recheck of spine_lengths, per-chapter length check
why: spineLengthsFromEpub throws on named entities and zip64; uploader-supplied lengths are untrusted input to the gate

decision: merged schema + RLS after rerunning the DB suite myself 4 times
why: worker said PASS; my first rerun failed the storage test, then 3 full runs passed; the worker proved the gate tests can fail by loosening policies

decision: left the storage-test flake open instead of adding a retry
why: evidence points to a cold storage container after db reset (30s timeout on first call), not a policy bug; a retry would hide a real regression

decision: P12 must compute sha256 and spine_lengths on the server and stop clients inserting book rows directly
why: book_insert policy trusts client-supplied spine_lengths, which feed the spoiler gate's pos math

decision: one WS-D worker does P11 then P12 in sequence
why: both need migrations and db reset on the single local Supabase; one owner avoids two workers resetting the same DB

decision: use opus instead of the configured haiku for feature workers
why: the haiku P01 worker fabricated a fixture and a wrong config yet reported PASS; rework costs more than the model

decision: auth is email + password via @supabase/ssr for v1
why: simplest for two partners to set up and for the verify harness to drive; OAuth can come later

decision: merged the reader engine after rerunning its e2e on master
why: e2e shows selection pos 4.504220 at 100% and 160%, identical to the spike; merge conflicts were additive (scripts, excludes)

decision: kept the next dev AGENTS.md block committed and added it to standing orders
why: next dev re-adds it on every run, the owner's other repos commit it, and reverting it only recreates the diff in every worker

decision: P14 must merge marks on the same range before painting
why: foliate keys highlights by CFI, so two partners highlighting the same sentence would draw once

decision: rebuilt the unmerged P12 commit with the 558 KB no-images Pride and Prejudice instead of the 24.8 MB edition
why: a 25 MB binary in git history is permanent; the worker already proved uploads above the 10 MB proxy limit once
evidence: commit 969a887; worker run showed 24.8 MB upload Added

decision: merged P11 + P12 after rerunning the worker's 3-account browser script on a master production build with uploads on
why: the first run skipped uploads (UPLOAD env flag), so I reran with it set rather than trusting the partial PASS

decision: queued: theme tokens so the default button has a background; export a zip entry reader from locator.ts and delete epub-meta's copy; move the couple script into tests/e2e
why: worker screenshots show transparent buttons; two unzip implementations will drift

decision: merged the verify skill, then fixed its launch on master by letting /dev routes skip the sign-in redirect in development
why: on master the P11 proxy 307'd /dev/reader so launch never saw 200; dev routes already 404 in production, so the guard belongs in the proxy, not a looser readiness check

decision: killed an orphaned next-server left by the P13a worker
why: a stray dev server from a finished worker was still listening; the next launch then exited early

decision: merged theme tokens and the couple e2e spec
why: buttons had no background; the throwaway couple script is now a permanent spec
